skill_name: Generate an essay summarizing information about the brain-computer interface technology.
workflow: Brain-computer interfaces (BCI) are technologies that allow individuals to directly interface their brains with a computer. This technology is being developed to give those with physical or cognitive impairments a way to use their minds to control their environment. BCI works by decoding brain signals, such as those associated with movement or thought. These signals can then be used to control a device, such as a wheelchair or a robotic prosthetic.
